workspace.name: WildChat · public research sample
workspace.description: A free public chatbot front-end (GPT-3.5 / GPT-4) whose users consented to research release of their conversations.

dataset.name: WildChat-1M
dataset.attribution: Zhao et al., "WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild", ICLR 2024
dataset.sample_note: Seeded uniform sample of 5,000 conversations from WildChat-1M shard 0, plus 40 planted canary conversations and 10 injection-bait fixtures used by the evaluation.

categories.title: Software development
categories.description: People write, fix and explain code across web, data, bots and games.

categories.title: Writing & editing
categories.description: People draft, rewrite, translate and condense text for school and work.

categories.title: Creative & role-play
categories.description: People co-write stories, scenarios, poems and interactive role-play.

categories.title: Image-prompt generation
categories.description: People use the assistant to write prompts and concepts for image generators.

categories.title: Learning & homework
categories.description: People work through problems, exam questions and explanations while studying.

categories.title: Business & career
categories.description: People write job applications, marketing material and business plans.

categories.title: Everyday advice
categories.description: People ask about current events, the assistant itself, and personal decisions.

categories.title: Other or unclear
categories.description: Conversations too short, too mixed or too unclear to place in a specific workflow.

clusters.title: Debugging Python and JavaScript errors
clusters.description: People paste an error or failing snippet and ask for the cause and a working fix.

needs.text: Explain what a traceback or console error actually means
Get a minimal fix that runs without rewriting the whole program
Understand why a library call behaves differently than expected

problems.text: Suggested fixes introduce a new error on the next run
Answers target an older library version than the one installed
Long files get truncated, so the fix misses the failing line

clusters.title: Building web apps and APIs
clusters.description: People scaffold front-end pages, back-end endpoints and database models for small web projects.

needs.text: Generate a complete, runnable project skeleton
Connect a front-end form to a back-end endpoint
Add authentication or payments to an existing app

problems.text: Generated code stops mid-file and has to be requested again
Framework versions are mixed within one answer
Deployment steps assume tools the person does not have

clusters.title: Building Discord and Telegram bots
clusters.description: People build chat bots with command handlers, scheduled posts and API integrations.

needs.text: Wire up bot commands and event handlers
Call a third-party API from inside a bot

problems.text: Library APIs changed after the model's training data
Tokens and intents setup is skipped in the instructions

clusters.title: Game scripting for Unity and Roblox
clusters.description: People write gameplay scripts, movement controllers and UI logic for hobby games.

needs.text: Write a character or camera controller from a description
Fix a script that compiles but does nothing in the game

problems.text: Engine-specific APIs are invented or misnamed
The model cannot see the scene setup the script depends on

clusters.title: Writing SQL and data-analysis scripts
clusters.description: People write queries, pandas transformations and spreadsheet formulas for their own data.

needs.text: Turn a plain-language question into a correct query
Clean and reshape a table before charting it

problems.text: Queries use a different SQL dialect than the person's database
Column names are guessed instead of asked for

clusters.title: Rewriting essays to sound human
clusters.description: People ask for essays or paragraphs to be rephrased so they read as human-written and pass AI detectors.

needs.text: Rephrase text so it no longer reads as machine-written
Keep the original argument while changing the wording

problems.text: Rewrites are rejected as still sounding generated, prompting repeated attempts
Meaning drifts after several rounds of paraphrasing
The person reports a detector score and asks to try again

clusters.title: Translating and polishing work emails
clusters.description: People translate messages between languages and adjust tone for colleagues and clients.

needs.text: Translate a message while keeping a professional tone
Make a short email more polite or more direct
Check grammar in a second language before sending

problems.text: Formality level does not match the recipient
Names and product terms get translated when they should not

clusters.title: Drafting academic papers and literature reviews
clusters.description: People outline, draft and expand thesis chapters, reports and literature reviews.

needs.text: Expand an outline into a structured chapter
Find and cite relevant prior work
Meet a specific word count and format

problems.text: Citations are invented or cannot be verified
Word-count targets are missed and re-requested
The model cannot read papers behind the links provided

clusters.title: Summarizing and paraphrasing articles
clusters.description: People paste long passages and ask for summaries, key points or simplified versions.

needs.text: Condense a long text into a few key points
Simplify dense material for a younger reader

problems.text: Pasted text exceeds the length the model can take in
Summaries add claims that are not in the source

clusters.title: Continuing fan-fiction and story episodes
clusters.description: People develop long-running stories with recurring characters, asking for the next episode again and again.

needs.text: Continue a story consistently from where it stopped
Keep characters' names, traits and relationships stable
Write longer episodes with dialogue

problems.text: Characters' details drift between episodes
Episodes end early and have to be continued manually

clusters.title: Anime and game crossover scenarios
clusters.description: People write what-if scenes where characters from different franchises meet and react to each other.

needs.text: Stage a crossover between characters from different series
Produce many short variations on the same premise

problems.text: Canon details for lesser-known characters are wrong
Requests are declined when scenes involve conflict

clusters.title: Role-play with unrestricted personas
clusters.description: People ask the assistant to adopt a persona that ignores its usual rules, then test what it will say.

needs.text: Keep an assigned persona for the whole conversation
Get answers the default assistant declines to give

problems.text: The assistant breaks character and declines
People complain the persona instructions were ignored
The same setup prompt is pasted several times in a row

clusters.title: Poems, song lyrics and jokes
clusters.description: People ask for short creative pieces for occasions, friends and social posts.

needs.text: Write a short poem for a specific person or occasion
Make a joke or pun on a given topic

problems.text: Rhymes and meter break in non-English poems
Jokes are explained rather than landed

clusters.title: Writing Midjourney / Stable Diffusion prompts
clusters.description: A pasted template asks for batches of structured image-generator prompts from a short concept, repeated at high volume.

needs.text: Turn a one-line concept into several detailed image prompts
Follow a strict output format with style and aspect-ratio flags

problems.text: Output format drifts from the template's required structure
Batches repeat the same composition with small wording changes

clusters.title: Designing logos and visual concepts
clusters.description: People describe a brand or scene and ask for design ideas, color palettes or an image.

needs.text: Get concrete visual directions for a logo or poster
Receive an actual image rather than a description

problems.text: The assistant cannot produce images, only describe them
Palette suggestions ignore stated brand colors

clusters.title: Solving math and physics problems
clusters.description: People paste problem sets and ask for step-by-step solutions and final answers.

needs.text: See each step of the solution, not only the answer
Check their own answer against a worked solution

problems.text: Arithmetic slips lead to a wrong final answer
Diagrams and formulas lose meaning when pasted as text

clusters.title: Answering exam and quiz questions
clusters.description: People paste multiple-choice or short-answer questions, often many in a row, and ask for the answers.

needs.text: Get the correct option with a one-line reason
Work through a long list of questions quickly

problems.text: Confident answers are wrong and the person corrects them
Questions that reference a figure cannot be answered

clusters.title: Explaining science, history and economics
clusters.description: People ask for plain-language explanations of concepts, events and theories.

needs.text: Understand a concept at a chosen level of detail
Compare two theories or events side by side

problems.text: Dates and figures are stated with false precision
Explanations stay too abstract for the person's level

clusters.title: Practising English and other languages
clusters.description: People ask for grammar explanations, vocabulary drills and corrections of their own sentences.

needs.text: Get corrections with the reason for each change
Practise conversation at a beginner level

problems.text: Corrections change the person's meaning
Replies switch to English when practice was in another language

clusters.title: Writing cover letters and resumes
clusters.description: People tailor resumes and cover letters to specific job postings.

needs.text: Match a resume to the wording of a job posting
Describe experience with stronger, measurable language

problems.text: Achievements are inflated beyond what the person gave
Letters are too long for the requested format

clusters.title: Marketing copy, SEO and social posts
clusters.description: People produce product descriptions, SEO articles and batches of social media posts.

needs.text: Write many variants of a post for different platforms
Include target keywords without sounding forced

problems.text: Copy repeats the same phrasing across variants
Keyword and length requirements are dropped

clusters.title: Business plans and startup ideas
clusters.description: People brainstorm business ideas and draft plans, pitches and financial outlines.

needs.text: Test whether an idea has an obvious market
Draft a one-page plan with rough numbers

problems.text: Market figures cannot be sourced or checked
Plans stay generic across very different ideas

clusters.title: Getting real-time info the model can't access
clusters.description: People ask for today's news, prices, weather or links, which the assistant cannot retrieve.

needs.text: Get current prices, scores or news
Open and read a link the person shares

problems.text: The assistant explains it has no internet access or recent data
People rephrase the same request hoping for live data

clusters.title: Asking which model the assistant is
clusters.description: People ask whether they are talking to GPT-4, what its knowledge cutoff is, and who runs the service.

needs.text: Confirm which model version is answering
Understand the service's limits before relying on it

problems.text: Answers about the model's identity are inconsistent
The assistant cannot state its own version reliably

clusters.title: Health, fitness and relationship advice
clusters.description: People describe a personal situation and ask what to do next.

needs.text: Get practical next steps for a personal situation
Build a simple workout or meal plan

problems.text: Advice defers to professionals without a concrete next step
Follow-up questions ignore details already given

clusters.title: Other or unclear
clusters.description: Greetings, single-word messages, tests and conversations with no clear goal.

needs.text: Test whether the assistant is working

problems.text: Very short openings get generic replies
